habitat: Evergreen forest; dipterocarp forest; swamp forest; heath forest; forest edge; secondary forest; and plantations
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Black And Yellow Broadbill (Eurylaimus ochromalus) stands out. This species, part of the Eurylaimidae family, is a resident of Evergreen forest; dipterocarp forest; swamp forest; heath forest; forest edge; secondary forest; and plantations. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Black And Yellow Broadbill is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Black And Yellow Broadbill and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
